newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen mostly sideways to slightly up.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa seen mostly sideways to slightly up.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE July cocoa is trying to erase its downside risk, but stiff resistance just above Friday's close is putting a cap on any rise, analysts said.
July was called to open five stg above Friday's close to edge up above initial resistance at 1,020 stg per tonne.
But gains above 1,020 had proved hard to sustain.
On Friday, "intra-day, it broke above it but couldn't stay and close above it," said independent technical analyst Elli Gifford.
"It will attempt (to break through) the upside, but I suspect it won't make it," she said.
But July support at 995 should hold to keep cocoa in a comfortable range, she said.
New York cocoa futures ended broadly lower Friday in a technical correction to Thursday's run-up to six-week highs, traders said.
"It was overbought," said Rich Wistisen, an analyst with Commodity Information. "This was just a mop-up of yesterday."
Also on Friday, London cocoa futures reversed course again in the afternoon to end mixed, weighed down by commercial selling in New York.
